hypothesis: The combination of LiCoO2 and graphite as electrode materials will result in a higher energy density compared to lithium metal alone
prediction: A battery using LiCoO2 and graphite electrodes will have 1.5 times the energy density of a lithium metal battery
measurement_method: Compare the energy density (Wh/kg) of a full cell with LiCoO2 cathode and graphite anode versus a lithium metal anode with the same cathode material
falsification_condition: If the energy density of the LiCoO2-graphite battery is less than or equal to that of the lithium metal battery
